description: Brushed-copper teapot: hollow LatheGeometry body (SplineCurve-smoothed belly, flared rim, inner wall), foot ring, domed lid as a second lathe with stalk and knob, curved spout as TubeGeometry on a CatmullRomCurve3 with torus lip, arched handle tube with ferrule spheres at both ends. Groups: body, lid, spout, handle.

Square upholstered stool: rounded cushion from a rounded-rect Shape extruded with bevel, four tapered splayed legs (geometry translated so the pivot is at the top, group tilted), brass foot caps, apron and foot-stretcher rings from a shared box. Groups: seat, legs, rails.

Chef's knife along Z (tip forward): blade outline drawn as a Shape (straight spine, dropped tip, curved belly) extruded 4 mm with bevel and rotated so length runs along +Z; lathe-turned oval green grip extending to -Z, steel bolster, dark butt cap, three shared-geometry rivets. Groups: blade, handle.

Yellow-green apple: LatheGeometry profile with top and bottom dimples, subtle 5-lobe ribbing by deterministic vertex displacement, 64x64 DataTexture skin (red blush on one side, lenticel specks), curved tube stem and a ShapeGeometry leaf. Parts: body, stem, leaf.
